title: 12 Best Beijing Dumpling Houses
description: Discover the 12 best Beijing dumpling houses for 2026. From traditional jiaozi to xiaolongbao, find authentic flavors and local favorites in Beijing, China.

places.name: Baoyuan Jiaozi Wu (宝源饺子屋)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their mixed platters, especially the 'Five Colors' dumpling plate with pork and chives or shrimp and egg fillings.

places.name: Mr. Shi's Dumplings (老石饺子)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Beijing Belly' dumplings (pork and cabbage) or the 'Cheese and Beef' if you're feeling adventurous.

places.name: Din Tai Fung (鼎泰丰)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Classic Pork Xiao Long Bao (小笼包) and Shrimp & Pork Wontons in Spicy Sauce.

places.name: Qing-Feng Steamed Dumpling Shop (庆丰包子铺)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pork and Leek Steamed Buns (猪肉大葱包子) or the traditional Boiled Jiaozi (水饺) with pork and cabbage.

places.name: Dongbei Ren (东北人)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pork and Suan Cai (Pickled Cabbage) Dumplings (猪肉酸菜水饺) or Mackerel Fish Dumplings (鲅鱼饺子).

places.name: Jinsong Dumpling City (劲松饺子城)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Boiled Lamb and Carrot Dumplings (羊肉胡萝卜水饺) or Shrimp, Pork, and Chive Dumplings (虾仁猪肉韭菜饺子).

places.name: Lao Bian Dumpling (老边饺子)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Special Steamed Dumplings' (煸馅饺子) which are their signature, known for their rich, savory fillings.

places.name: Huguosi Snacks (护国寺小吃)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Boiled Pork and Cabbage Dumplings (猪肉白菜水饺) with a side of 'Lvdagun' (rolled donkey), a sweet glutinous rice cake.

places.name: Yuanmen Dumpling (圆门饺子)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Classic Pork and Fennel Dumplings (猪肉茴香水饺) or Chicken and Mushroom Dumplings (鸡肉蘑菇水饺).

places.name: Kong Yiji (孔乙己)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pan-fried Pork Potstickers (猪肉锅贴) or their delicate steamed shrimp dumplings (虾饺).

places.name: Xiaochun Dumpling (小春饺子馆)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pork and Celery Dumplings (猪肉芹菜水饺) or Egg and Chive Dumplings (鸡蛋韭菜水饺).

places.name: Xiabu Xiabu (呷哺呷哺)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pork and Cabbage Dumplings (猪肉白菜饺子) or Shrimp Dumplings (虾饺), cooked in a spicy (mala) or mushroom broth.
